run.gasTable: built-in, main-network schedule (local Hardhat, hardfork osaka, 2026-10-12, final contracts)
run.fees: tip at least 0.2 gwei, maximum fee 2 x base fee + tip
run.orderTotalRule: ORDER_TOTAL_WEI (given); default rule: smallest multiple of 0.001 ETH that is at least 2 x the gas stipend (eth_gasPrice at the start x 2,400,000), at least 0.001 ETH

cycle.formula: gas used x effective gas price of each transaction, summed; x the ETH/USD rate

notes: Hoodi: other users share the blocks; block packing and base fee include their transactions.
